description.value:
Sturdy design and a tiny merc’s mods – an explosive combination.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic Assault Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 7d6, Drop 2 Lowest • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified High-Velocity Ammunition (500eb [Expensive] per 10) that also functions like an Explosive when interacting with Cover for the purposes of carrying damage to targets behind destroyed Cover. Whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (15 Total). Targets hit by this weapon must also succeed on a DV15 Athletics Check or else be knocked Prone.

Reloading this weapon requires 2 Reload Actions. Requires BODY 11+, paired Cyberarms, or being Mounted to not reduce the user’s MOVE by 2 while wielded and inflict the Torn Muscle Critical Injury when fired.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 7d6, dropping the 2 lowest dice. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
